note: Isometry, vacuum, translation intertwining, uniqueness (`attach`, ∃!) and the ground-projection limit are stated. The heat identity J e^{-sH} = E_s J appears as the definition `bHeat = J* E_s J` together with its Boltzmann form, not as an intertwining equation.

structure Intervenes (W : X→L[ℂ] C.H) (v : X) : Prop where
  scale (x : X) : ‖W x‖=‖x‖
  across (p) : W.comp (P.orbit.translation p) = (C.flow.unit.translation p).comp W
  start : W v=C.omega

proof_context.conclusion: `Intervenes` records that `U` is isometric (`scale`), sends the vacuum to the OS vacuum (`start`) and intertwines spatial translations (`across`).

theorem FieldCore.attach (H : FieldCore W R h F) (P : DiffPlan S) (hs : S.Symmetric) (hP : P.Inclusions S)
    (w : B.concretized A) (int : Y.NonTangentialFree W)
    (hw : Bid.Hull B Y F.J) (lamp : B.Lamp W F.J F.spin) :
    ∃! U : F.operators.H →L[ℂ] V.H, Attachment F V U := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hθ⟩ := H.coupling lamp
  refine ⟨U, ⟨hU, ⟨A, B, w⟩, fun n v => ?_⟩, fun L k => Kernel.Gram.by_bud H.soil
    (fun b => tendsto_nhds_unique (k.traces w b) (hθ b))⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ, hW⟩ := joints hU.scale hθ int F.J hw v
  refine ⟨Ψ, hΨ, fun A₁ B₁ hb f => ?_⟩
  apply (hW f).congr'
  filter_upwards [heights_valid n] with i hi
  exact hot_eq (bar_eq w hb P hs hP i.1 hi.2.1.1) n v i.2 f

proof_context.conclusion: There is a unique `U` with `Attachment F V U`, via `Kernel.Gram.by_bud` and uniqueness of the limits of the boundary words.

lemma bHeat_pair (I : Attachment X V J) (H : FieldCore W U h X) (s : ℝ≥0) (x : X.operators.H) :
    inner ℂ x (bHeat J s x)=(↑(∫ p, boltz s p ∂X.momentum.diagonal x):ℂ) := by
  unfold bHeat; rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, I.measures H]
  exact boltzmann _ _ _

proof_context.conclusion: `bHeat J s = J* E_s J` has the Boltzmann quadratic form `∫ boltz s p d(momentum.diagonal x)`, which is the heat `e^{-sH}` on the boundary side.

lemma bHeat_limit (I : Attachment X V J) (H : FieldCore W U h X) (x : X.operators.H) :
    Tendsto (fun s => bHeat J s x) atTop (𝓝 (X.momentum.region zeroE x)) := by
  have he := V.flow.emerges (J x)
  rw [reflection_projection,← I.projections H zeroE zeroE_m] at he
  have hJ (y : X.operators.H) : J.adjoint (J y)=y :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (J.norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self.mp I.acts.scale) y
  have hp := (J.adjoint.continuous.continuousAt (x:=J (X.momentum.region zeroE x))).tendsto.comp he
  rw [hJ] at hp; exact hp

proof_context.conclusion: `bHeat J s x` tends to the zero-energy projection `momentum.region zeroE x` as `s` grows, using that `J` is isometric, which identifies the ground projections.
